title: A unified family of counterexamples to Batyrev's non-negativity conjecture on stringy Hodge numbers
summary: Recently, Huang and Satriano determined the sharp dimension threshold for Batyrev's non-negativity conjecture on stringy Hodge numbers: the conjecture holds in dimensions at most four and fails in every dimension at least five. We show that their counterexamples fit into a single broad three-parameter family $Y_{m,d}:=V(\sum_{i=0}^m s_i g_i(x)+h(x))\subset\mathbb{P}^{m+d+1}$, where each $g_i$ is homogeneous of degree $d-1$ and $h$ is homogeneous of degree $d$, whose singular locus is a linear space $Λ\cong\mathbb{P}^m$.
